# Davide Bert — Senior Software Developer

> Full-Stack Engineer with 8+ years of experience. Enterprise systems by day. Privacy-first AI by night.

## About

Davide Bert is a Senior Software Developer currently working at ewo in Cortaccia, Italy. He has 8+ years of experience shipping software — from enterprise logistics at Fercam to leading the smart factory platform at Röchling Automotive, where he grew from specialist to team leader, digitalizing 22 manufacturing plants and optimizing 400+ production lines worldwide. Today he builds enterprise solutions at ewo and works on privacy-first local AI, agentic systems, and self-hosted tools.

## Current Role

- **Position**: Senior Software Developer at ewo (2025 — Present)
- **Technologies**: .NET, C#, ASP.NET, Vue.js, Kubernetes, Pulumi
- **Location**: Trento, Italy

## Key Projects

- **RaccBuddy**: Open-source AI companion that runs 100% locally — no cloud, no data ever leaving your machine — using LangGraph, Ollama, and pgvector.
- **Miner Sentinel**: Open-source monitoring tool for cryptocurrency mining operations.
- **NebulaProxy**: Self-hosted reverse proxy solution.

## Technical Skills

- **Backend & APIs**: Python, Django, C#, .NET, FastAPI, REST APIs
- **Frontend & Mobile**: Vue.js, React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
- **AI / LLM / Agents**: LangGraph, Ollama, pgvector, RAG, Agentic Systems
- **Databases & DevOps**: PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Pulumi, CI/CD
- **Leadership & Domain**: Team Leadership, Smart Factory, Industry 4.0
